name: qa-resilience
description: Chaos engineering and resilience drills: chaos experiment design, Chaos Mesh and Toxiproxy fault injection, disaster recovery drills, error-budget gates. Covers steady-state hypotheses with LitmusChaos and Gremlin routing, a drill run protocol with pre-flight and abort gates, combined HTTP and TCP fault injection, backup restore and RTO measurement, and burn-rate alerting with MTTR / MTBF / MTTD / MTTA incident metrics.
